Leaves of Absence

(Northwind Employees)



Purpose:

The purpose of this policy is to provide insight into the different types of Leave of Absences (“LOA”) offered.



Policy:

A leave of absence is an employment status for an employee who is approved for extended time away from work for a specific reason, such as medical or personal. To request any leave below, please notify Human Resources (human.resource@northwind-traders.com) as soon as possible once the need for the leave becomes known to you.



Please Note: STD/LTD cannot be used in conjunction or to subsidize Worker’s Compensation.



Any employee who fails to file a claim or provide the required documentation within the specified timeframe or according to the organization's guidelines. Failure to comply with these requirements may result in delays or issues with receiving regular earnings.



Types of Leave:

Bereavement

Coping with the loss of a loved one is difficult; we recognize this and offer bereavement leave of up to five days to all its employees as of their hire date. Time off for bereavement leave is paid.



Time Allowances:

 Maximum of 10 days off with pay is permitted upon the death of a regular employee’s:  

Spouse/Domestic Partner

Children/Stepchildren

Parents/Stepparents

Siblings/Stepsiblings

Legal guardians/Persons for whom you serve as a legal guardian

Maximum of 5 days off with pay for a reproductive loss:

Miscarriage

Stillbirth

Failed adoption or surrogacy

Unsuccessful assisted reproduction

Maximum of 3 days off with pay is permitted upon the death of a regular employee's:

Grandparents

Grandchildren

Mother-in-law, Father-in-law, Sister-in-law, Brother-in-law

Maximum of 1 day off with pay is permitted upon the death of a regular staff member's:

Aunts/Uncles/Cousins

Niece/Nephew

Relatives living in the household



Time off related to the death of any other person may be granted as PTO if available or on an unpaid basis, depending on Northwind Traders’s business needs.

Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)

As an employee, you may be entitled to a leave of absence under the Family and Medical Leave Act (“FMLA”) and/or state law, including the California Family Rights Act (“CFRA”). This policy is intended to provide you with information concerning FMLA or similar state law entitlements and obligations you may have during such leave. 

	

The FMLA provides eligible employees up to 12 work weeks of unpaid leave for certain family and medical reasons during a 12-month period. The 12-month period is rolling, which means the 12-month period is measured backward from the date leave is taken and continuous with each additional leave day taken.



For details, please review the “Family and Medical Leave” policy.



Jury Duty

If you are called to perform jury duty, a leave of absence will be granted. Upon completion of your jury service, please submit verification of attendance from the court and payment received for jury duty. 



To the extent applicable state law is more generous than this policy, the Company will provide leave in accordance with applicable State Law. 



The Company will pay employees their base salary while on documented Jury Leave up to a maximum of 30 days per calendar year, in a manner consistent with applicable law.



Paid Caregiver Leave

Northwind Traders may provide up to six (6) weeks of paid Caregiver Leave in a 12-month period to an eligible employee to care for the employee’s spouse, domestic partner, child, or parent who has a serious health condition. 



For details, please review the “Paid Caregiver Leave” policy.

Parental Leave

This leave provides eligible employees with full paid time off from work, to care for and/or bond with newborn or newly adopted child. 

Northwind Traders will grant up to 10 weeks of full paid time off to eligible employees.

New parents by birth or adoption are eligible. 

Must be taken within 1 year of birth/adoption at a minimum of 1-week increments (Monday – Friday).  

For birth mothers, this leave begins no sooner than at the conclusion of STD benefits.

Benefits run concurrently with FMLA, applicable state leaves, and Company Paid Holidays.

Where both parents work for the Company, only one employee at a time can receive Paid Parental Leave to bond with the same child.



Unpaid Personal Leave

Northwind Traders supports our employees in need of requesting necessary extended time away from work. The intent of this policy is to outline the details and process for requesting an unpaid personal leave of absence (LOA). Generally, may not exceed 60 calendar days during any 24-month period.



For details, please review the “Unpaid Personal Leave” policy.

Voting Leave

An employee who has less than four (4) hours between the opening/closing of the election polls and the start/finish of his/her work time are entitled to two (2) hours with pay to vote. The Company designates the time in which the employee may leave to vote, and the employee must notify the Company between 2 and 10 days before the election of his/her need to leave work to vote. Where applicable State law provides leave more generous than this policy, the Company will fully comply with applicable State voting leave law. 



(Applies to Mumm Napa and Kenwood) 

Employees who are registered voters are entitled to time off from work if necessary to vote in local, state, and national elections. Such time will be paid if the employee cannot vote prior to or after work. The employee must inform his/her supervisor/manager two days in advance if they need the time off. Typically, the polls open at 7:00 a.m. and close at 8:00 p.m. Most employees should have adequate time to vote without having to take additional time away from work. Paid time off for voting must be approved by a supervisor/manager.



Witness Duty

The Company will not take any adverse employment action against an employee who participates as a witness in a court proceeding or exercises his/her rights as a victim of a crime, despite his/her absence from work. An employee must notify his/her supervisor/manager of his/her intention to appear as a witness, to consult with the district attorney, or to exercise other rights, prior to the day of attendance. 



If the employee takes unpaid witness duty leave, the employee must provide verification of the employee’s service.

Modified Work Program 

(Applies to Fort Smith, Mumm Napa, and Kenwood Employees)

This program is designed to provide an employee an opportunity to return to the workplace and perform value-added tasks consistent with their capabilities. Modified work assignments are subject to conditions including availability of work as well as local work rules. These locations may provide modified work assignments to production employees on a temporary basis where the employee has medically documented temporary limitation that prevents the employee from performing at least some of his/her job functions in the usual manner.



Modified work assignments are temporary (usually less than 90 days) and are designed to help an employee return to regular duty; they are not permanent job assignments. If an injury, illness or other medical condition prevents an employee from performing at least some of his/her job functions in the usual manner on a temporary basis, the employee should contact Human Resources to request a modified duty assignment. The Company will require that any employee requesting a modified duty assignment provide a note from a medical provider documenting the medical condition requiring modified duty and the duration of the medical impairment.

Product Refunds and Exchanges
1.1 Refund Policy
(a) Unless otherwise required by applicable law, the Company will:
(i) refund one hundred percent (100%) of the price, less applicable Bonuses (plus applicable
tax if prepaid) to you on unopened and resalable Business Support Materials sold by the
Company to you that are returned within sixty (60) days from the date on which the
Business Support Materials are shipped to you or collected by you; or
(ii) refund one hundred percent (100%) of the price, less applicable Bonuses (plus applicable
tax if prepaid) to you on unopened and resalable Products (except Business Support
Materials) sold by the Company to you that are returned within ninety (90) days from the
date on which the Products are shipped to or collected by you; or
(iii) after deducting an administrative fee equivalent to 10% of the price, refund ninety
percent (90%) of the price, less applicable Bonuses (plus applicable tax if prepaid) to you
on unopened and resalable Products (except Business Support Materials) sold by the
Company to you that are returned (1) after expiry of the return period specified in
paragraph (ii) above; and (2) within the period of 12 months from the date of purchase.
The Company does not refund the original shipping costs on Products that you
return. In order for the Company to correctly back out the applicable Bonuses on
returned Products, you must keep the sales order number from the invoice. You
must provide the sales order number to the Company at the time you request a
refund. You may also return individual Products that are purchased as part of a kit or
package. The form of the refund will be based on the original form of payment such
as a bank transfer or a credit card charge. Instead of a refund, the Company may
choose other alternatives such as a Product credit.

to the address as provided by you at reasonable delivery charges and if such Products and/or
Business Support Materials cannot be successfully delivered to you and you fail or neglect for

within three (3) months from the date of purchase; or
2) where you have requested the Company and the Company has agreed to deliver any Products
and/or Business Support Materials to you but the Company is unable to deliver such Products
and/or Business Support Materials to you due to an incorrect or incomplete delivery address or
the unavailability of the named recipient at the address as provided by you, and you fail or

THEN upon the expiry of the aforesaid period of three (3) months, the Company shall, without further

2.1 Retail Sales
Products purchased from the Company may only be sold to retail customers, used for Product
demonstrations, or for your own personal use. You are authorized to resell Products you purchase
from the Company to retail customers. Subject to the terms hereinbelow, you may establish your

The Company has established suggested retail prices for Products based on competitive pricing in
each market. Maintaining retail pricing for non-Brand Affiliates helps to preserve the value of the
Company’s Products and business opportunity. The Company may take disciplinary measures,
including possible termination of a Brand Affiliate Account, in the event the Company determines
that a Brand Affiliate Account resells Products at price levels that impair the viability of bona fide
retail pricing for other Brand Affiliate Accounts. The selling of the Company’s Products in the market

2.2 No Wholesaling of Products
You may not sell or distribute Products to Persons who intend to resell the Products, or have resold
Products in the past. You are prohibited from selling to Persons, either directly or indirectly, who
ultimately (i) resell the Products through a retail store, (ii) resell the Products over the Internet,

in writing, (iii) import the Products into an Unopened Market, or (iv) use any other method of
distribution that violates the primary purpose of your direct selling business and that of the
Company. You must take reasonable steps to ensure that Persons who purchase Products from you
do not intend to violate this Section 5.2.
2.3 Retail Sales Receipts
You must provide Retail Sales Receipts to your customers in accordance with the following
requirements:
(a) You must provide the customer with two copies of the completed Retail Sales Receipt at the
time of the sale. All blanks in the section referring to the seven-day refund policy on the back
of the receipt must be completed. The Retail Sales Receipt should be completed and include
the items ordered, the amount of the sale, and the customer’s name, address, telephone
number, the date of the sale, your name, business address, and business telephone number.
(b) You must keep a copy of the Retail Sales Receipt for your records. You must keep copies of
all Retail Sales Receipts on file for at least four years.

Retail Customers
(a) You must offer a seven-day money-back guarantee to your retail customers. This means that
you must, for any reason and upon request, give a full refund of the purchase price to the
customer. The only requirement is that the customer must request the refund within seven
business days of purchase and return the unused portion of Product. You must make a
refund for returned Products within 10 days of the customer’s request.

SHIPPING & DELIVERY POLICY
Last Updated: 2025

This Shipping & Delivery Policy (“Policy”) describes how Northwind Traders (“Company”, “we”, “us”, “our”) handles the shipping, delivery, and logistics of products purchased through the Pet Univerzum platform (“Services”).

By placing an order, you agree to the terms outlined in this Policy.

1. DELIVERY AREAS
1.1 Deliveries are currently available within the territory of the Republic of Serbia.  
1.2 Express in-house delivery may be available in selected cities.  
1.3 International shipping is not supported at this time unless explicitly stated.

2. SHIPPING PARTNERS
2.1 We cooperate with licensed courier services operating in Serbia.  
2.2 Courier assignments may vary depending on location, product type, and availability.

3. DELIVERY TIMES
3.1 Estimated delivery times are displayed during checkout.  
3.2 Delivery time may vary due to:  
– courier workload,  
– weather conditions,  
– holidays,  
– product availability,  
– operational or technical delays.  

3.3 These estimates are not guaranteed.

4. SHIPPING FEES
4.1 Shipping fees are calculated based on:  
– delivery address,  
– courier pricing,  
– product weight and size.  
4.2 Shipping fees are shown before finalizing the order.

5. ORDER PROCESSING
5.1 Orders placed before the daily cutoff time are processed the same day.  
5.2 Orders placed after cutoff time or on holidays may be processed the next business day.

6. FAILED DELIVERY ATTEMPTS
6.1 If the courier is unable to deliver due to incorrect address, absence of the recipient, or other user-caused issues, additional delivery attempts may incur extra fees.  
6.2 If the package is returned to us, the user may be responsible for reshipping costs.

7. RISK OF LOSS
7.1 Risk passes to the user once the package is handed to the courier.  
7.2 We are not responsible for delays, damage, or loss caused by courier services.
